bug_fixes: Download stream resolution now honors the selected audio quality and isolates cached stream URLs by quality.
Welcome onboarding is now persisted as a first-launch experience instead of being shown again after every version change.
First-tap playback now uses Media3 play/pause commands so an idle player prepares and starts without requiring a second tap.
YouTube account handoff now opens YouTube Music directly so an existing authenticated web session can be reused without the generic Google ServiceLogin hop.
